== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Peace is the message that [[Bill Martinson]] of Decipher and Star Trek: Deep Space Nine's [[Aron Eisenberg]] are promoting." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
